page.title: Permission Rules
page.subtitle: Restrict tools, MCP servers and usage rate per user, or override persona, model, local command execution and global memory (default config profile).

rules.title: Rules
rules.subtitle: Each rule is a permission group. Rules match top to bottom; the first enabled rule whose conditions match the sender applies, and whatever it leaves unset comes from the rule it inherits. Senders matching no rule get the default (unrestricted) policy.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Everyone uses the default policy.
rules.name: Name

match.syntaxTitle: Match condition syntax (a rule matches when any of its conditions matches):
match.syntaxSender: that sender anywhere (private or group chats)
match.label: Match conditions
match.hint: Press Enter, space or comma after each condition: 123456/7890, p_7890, g_123456, role:admin, role:member, *
match.errorRole: "{condition}": role must be admin or member
match.errorSyntax: "{condition}" is not a valid condition and will never match
match.errorNone: This rule has no conditions and no rule inherits it, so it never applies
match.template: No conditions (a template other rules inherit)

fields.toolsAllowHint: Tool name globs (e.g. web_*). If set, only matching tools may be called.
fields.toolsDenyHint: Tool name globs that may never be called. Deny always wins.
fields.mcpAllowHint: MCP server name globs. If set, only tools from matching servers may be called.
fields.mcpDenyHint: MCP server name globs whose tools may never be called. Deny always wins.
fields.personaHint: Overrides the persona for matching senders.
fields.modelHint: Overrides the Codex model for matching senders. Leave empty to use the default.
fields.modelCacheWarning: Switching the model mid-thread discards the prompt cache, so the next turn costs more.
fields.globalMemoryHint: Whether this sender's private chats may write to the global memory store (only when Codex memories are enabled).
fields.inheritsHint: Unset fields (empty lists, no override, inherit) come from the selected rule, over several levels. Match conditions and the enabled switch are not inherited.

tester.title: Test a sender
tester.subtitle: Check which rule a sender matches with the rules being edited (including unsaved changes), and the effective policy after inheritance.
tester.noMatch: No rule matches; the default (unrestricted) policy applies.

messages.unsavedChangesLeaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page anyway?
messages.invalidConditionsConfirm: Some enabled rules have problems. Save anyway?
messages.deleteParentConfirm: Delete rule "{name}"? {count} rule(s) inherit it and will inherit its parent instead.

rateLimit.title: Rate limit
rateLimit.modeHint: Counts requests sent to the agent per account (scheduled tasks and background-task wake-ups excluded); one account shares its count across all chats.
rateLimit.replyPlaceholder: 请求太频繁了，请 {wait} 后再试（限制：{limit}）。
rateLimit.replyHint: Use {wait} (time left) and {limit} (the limit hit). Sent once per refusal period; leave empty to inherit or use the default, which is in Chinese.
rateLimit.slidingHint: Sliding window: each use frees up one window after it happened, rather than the whole count resetting. Every limit must hold.
rateLimit.errorRow: invalid rate limit (count must be a positive integer, window 1 second to 30 days)
rateLimit.errorEmpty: custom rate limit has no valid limits; it saves as "Unlimited" (overriding inherited limits)

cronLimit.title: Scheduled tasks
cronLimit.maxTasksHint: Most scheduled tasks an account keeps on this platform; 0 is no limit. Empty inherits; unset everywhere, members get 1 and admins no limit.
cronLimit.intervalHint: Least hours between two runs of a recurring task; 0 is no limit. Empty inherits; unset everywhere, members get 6 hours and admins no limit.
cronLimit.errorNumber: Scheduled-task limits must be numbers of 0 or more (whole tasks)
